items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: And Billy Eckstine. I'm crazy to get in touch with him.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, I think she's adorable. She's adorable. And I like -- I like Sammy, but I'm mad with Sammy because I've written him several letters and he didn't answer. And I know Sammy so well, he shouldn't put on the ritz with me, because I know him so well, see. And Billy Eckstine. I'm crazy to get in touch with him. I sent him a letter and sent it registered special and requested a return letter.
Well, I'm going to help you with that.
